patch_description: Add a bounded stall controller that measures progress using legal route length, avoiding false stalls on winding paths. Repeated position–target cycles trigger a short, low-risk observation detour, selected using route cost, distance to the original objective, and fresh observation opportunities. Detours expire after six decisions and have a cooldown. During recovery, waiting receives an additional penalty only when a low-hazard immediate move exists. Normal planning, learned dynamics, and visible-enemy exclusion remain intact. This targets avoidable waiting without globally reducing survival pressure; performance improvement remains to be evaluated.
